# Rumble (5 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search Rumble videos |
| /channel/videos | `handle` / `url` | 1 | List videos for a Rumble channel |
| /video | `url` | 1 | Get a Rumble video |
| /video/transcript | `url` | 10 | Get a Rumble video transcript — ⛔ **BANNED in this plugin: 10 credits, no advantage. Transcribe with the local captions→Groq→Whisper chain instead.** |
| /video/comments | `url` | 1 | List top-level comments on a Rumble video |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /search — 1cr

Searches Rumble videos by keyword. Returns matching videos and shorts with title, URL, thumbnail, channel, published date, view-count text + integer, plus a numeric cursor for the next page.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search query.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Cursor from the previous response — the next page number (e.g. `2`).

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /channel/videos — 1cr

Returns channel metadata, videos, shorts, and a numeric cursor for the next page. Pass either `handle` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `cursor` *(optional)*: Cursor from the previous response — the next page number (e.g. `2`).
- `handle` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `handle`: Rumble channel handle. (one of: handle, url — at least one required)
  - `url`: Rumble channel URL. (one of: handle, url — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/channel/videos?handle=<handle>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /video — 1cr

Returns title, description, thumbnail, channel, publish date, view count, likes, dislikes, captions, and media metadata when available.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Rumble video URL.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /video/transcript — 10cr

Returns the transcript for a Rumble video when captions are available. If Rumble doesn't expose captions, `transcript` is `null` and credits are not deducted.

> ⛔ **BANNED in this plugin: 10 credits, no advantage. Transcribe with the local captions→Groq→Whisper chain instead.**

**Parameters**

- `url`: Rumble video URL.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video/transcript?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /video/comments — 1cr

Returns all top-level comments for a Rumble video — comment text, author, `createdAt`, `createdAtText`, `likeCount`, `dislikeCount`, and `replyCount` when comment bodies are public.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Rumble video URL.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video/comments?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Rumble endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Find videos on a topic | `/search` | 1 |
| A channel's back catalogue | `/channel/videos` | 1 |
| One video's detail and stats | `/video` | 1 |
| Audience reaction | `/video/comments` | 1 |
| ~~Transcript~~ | ⛔ `/video/transcript` is **banned** — use the local Whisper chain | — |

Everything usable here is 1 credit, so Rumble is cheap to explore. There is no `/full`
composite and no profile endpoint — a creator's footprint is `/channel/videos` plus per-video
`/video` calls.

`prism/video-intel` (5cr) covers Rumble and returns detail + stats + top comments for one
video URL in a single call, which beats three separate 1cr calls once you want comments and
stats together.
